title: Repair & Maintenance work at Arnala lighthouse station.
summary: Repair and maintenance work at Arnala Lighthouse station, Post Arnala, via Virar, District Thane, Maharashtra.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

scope.item: Repair & Maintenance work at Arnala lighthouse station

money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, payable at Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; original to be submitted by post/in person. MSME/NSIC registered bidders are also required to submit EMD (no exemption).

period.completion: 06 Months (from the date of award of contract)
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of Technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category registered with Central Govt/State Govt/Municipal Corporation etc with tender limits equal to or more than estimated cost
Satisfactory completion of similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years: three works each >= 40%, or two works each >= 60%, or one work >= 80% of estimated cost
Documentary evidence of annual turnover of last three years
Permanent Account Number (Hindi version also lists GST number)
notes: NIT dated 15.01.2026. Bid download & submission 15/01/2026 09:00 to 05/02/2026 16:00; pre-bid meeting 23/01/2026 16:00 at Deep Bhavan, Mumbai; last date for original EMD 06/02/2026 17:00; technical bid opening 09/02/2026 11:00. Document is Section I only; no BOQ. Listing start date blank.
